basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old vape enthusiast and tech consultant from Portland, Oregon. I love exploring new products in the vape industry, especially those focused on CBD and Delta-8 THC. Outside of work, I'm a huge fan of BattleTech and enjoy customizing and modding my gear. In my spare time, I indulge in reality TV, particularly shows like 'Survivor.' I'm single, and I generally browse Reddit during evenings and weekends when I'm relaxing at home.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in information technology, having worked in the field for over a decade. My interest in vaping started as a hobby but has grown into a serious passion. I've educated myself through online resources, forums, and trial-and-error experimentation with various products. My expertise is a mix of self-taught knowledge and community-driven insights.
